dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: Dataset developed according to Arcadia project Methodology (Report: “Metodologia per gli studi di filiera della Banca Dati italiana LCA”). LCA study of electricity production from photovoltaic systems with 3 kWp plant (Report: “Filiera di produzione del mix elettrico italiano”). The dataset refers to the production of 1 kWh of electricity from photovoltaic systems in 3 kWp plants, in Italy, and it is representative of the processing technologies commonly used for this purpose. The dataset consists of 8 unit processes: 1) Electricity production from 3 kWp photovoltaic, in monocrystalline silicon installed on the façade (percentage contribution to the whole dataset: 3%). 2) Electricity production from from 3 kWp photovoltaic, in monocrystalline silicon installed on a flat roof (percentage contribution to the whole dataset: 14%). 3) Electricity production from from 3 kWp photovoltaic, in monocrystalline silicon installed on a slanted roof (percentage contribution to the whole dataset: 4%). 4) Electricity production from from 3 kWp photovoltaic, in polycrystalline silicon installed on the facade (percentage contribution to the whole dataset: 9%). 5) Electricity production from from 3 kWp photovoltaic, in polycrystalline silicon installed on a flat roof (percentage contribution to the whole dataset: 51%). 6) Electricity production from from 3 kWp photovoltaic, in polycrystalline silicon installed on a slanted roof (percentage contribution to the whole dataset: 15%). 7) Electricity production from from 3 kWp photovoltaic, in amorphous silicon installed on a slanted roof (percentage contribution to the whole dataset: 1%). 8) Electricity production from from 3 kWp photovoltaic, in thin film installed on a slanted roof (percentage contribution to the whole dataset: 3%).

referenceToExternalDocumentation.common:shortDescription:
Gabriella Fiorentino, Simona Scalbi, Antonietta Cerbone, Giuliana Ansanelli, Marco Giammartini, Amalia Zucaro. Filiera di produzione del mix elettrico italiano.
Background datasets from EcoInvent database cut-off (v.3.7.1) were used for the LCA study.

time.common:timeRepresentativenessDescription: This dataset has been considered valid until 2026, since no main changes have occurred in the electricity production from photovoltaic in the investigated years.

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse: The dataset (1 kWh of electricity from photovoltaic IT, 3 kWp) refers to a system that includes all processes, from the extraction of raw materials to produce the photovoltaic panels up to the production of 1 kWh of electricity (cradle-to-gate approach), taking into account the 20-year life time of the system and the insolation received in the reference year (primary data). The primary data were provided by photovoltaic solar statistical report from GSE (Gestore Servizi Energetici, 2019), and by PVGIS software that calculates the insolation received. For the LCA study, background datasets from EcoInvent database 3.7.1 cut-off were used.
technology.technologicalApplicability: Electricity from Italian electricity mix sold to Italian electric grid.

dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.dataCutOffAndCompletenessPrinciples: Production of equipment and infrastructures is not included, except for the background system

review.common:reviewDetails: The review was performed in compliance with Arcadia Metodology: “Metodologia per gli studi di filiera della Banca Dati italiana LCA” and ISO 14040-44 norms. The dataset has been assessed limited to the foreground data collected during the supply chain studies. Each dataset has been evaluated based on the following 4 criteria: 1. Technological Representativeness; 2. Time Representativeness; 3. Geographical Representativeness; 4. Reliability (A) In this context, the Reliability is very good.
review.common:otherReviewDetails: The study was judged by the reviewer as compliant with both ISO 14040-44 and Arcadia methodology.
